newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's CSP to make share offering on June 30/July 1. [corrected 16:13 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Italy's CSP to make share offering on June 30/July 1. [corrected 16:13 GMT]

text.p: Italian hosiery company CSP International Industria Calze SpA will carry out a market share offering on June 30 and July 1 (corrects date) ahead of a Milan bourse listing, the company said in a newspaper tombstone.
The share price, to be in a range between 12,000 and 15,000 lire, will be announced before the sale offer.
The overall offer is for 8.22 million ordinary shares of a nominal 1,000 lire each, of which 2.055 million will be offered to the public, including employees, and the rest placed privately.
Global coordinator for the operation is UBS and lead manager Cariplo.
CSP, ranked second in the domestic market, posted 1996 net profit of 10.5 billion lire against 2.1 billion in 1995 on sales of 233.7 billion lire versus 191.3 billion.
